rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user (no find_user_id_by_name_zip or get_user_details calls), did not retrieve order/product details, and did not request confirmation before any order-changing actions. It also did not actually perform the return or exchange. The only actions shown were a think and calculate step producing a combined savings figure, which relied on item prices not sourced from tools, violating the requirement against unsupported/fabricated information. Additionally, the user asked to know savings in both ways (return vs exchange) and the agent only gave a combined total. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
